kind.description: What this section IS, so the site can place and label it: examining (what this organisation's examiners look for), coaching (how it teaches the technique), safety (its local restrictions or matting rules), terminology (what it calls things), context (anything else worth saying).

localisedText.description: Text by BCP 47 language code; "en" required, other languages optional.

localisedSteps.description: Ordered movement steps per language (at least two); "en" required.

title: perspective
description: One organisation's voice on one thing, layered OVER the record for readers who opt into that organisation's view - never shown by default, never a fork. The file is filed by what it speaks about: perspectives/<organisation>/techniques/<slug>.json or perspectives/<organisation>/exams/<slug>.json, every part of the path existing in its own collection. A perspective ADDS context (what examiners look for, how the club teaches it, how to prepare for an examination, local safety rules, terminology); a disagreement with the canonical content is a pull request against that file for everyone, not a shadow version here. Techniques are canonical and org-neutral, so any organisation may speak on one - but the banned rule inherits, so a technique documented for recognition only takes no step-by-step here either. An exam is one organisation's document, so only that organisation and the bodies beneath it (its affiliates and their clubs) may speak on it - the natural home for preparation guidance the printed form deliberately has no field for.
